================================================================================
CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX with options
================================================================================

CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX AK_UnitMeasure_Name
ON Production.UnitMeasure (Name ASC, ModifiedDate DESC)
WITH (PAD_INDEX = OFF, FILLFACTOR = 80, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = ON, DROP_EXISTING = ON, ONLINE = ON (WAIT_AT_LOW_PRIORITY (MAX_DURATION = 1 MINUTES, ABORT_AFTER_WAIT = SELF)))
ON [PRIMARY];

================================================================================
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX with INCLUDE and a filter
================================================================================

CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX FIBillOfMaterialsWithEndDate
ON Production.BillOfMaterials (ComponentID, StartDate)
INCLUDE (ProductAssemblyID, PerAssemblyQty)
WHERE EndDate IS NOT NULL AND ComponentID > 5
WITH (DATA_COMPRESSION = ROW ON PARTITIONS (2, 4 TO 6))
ON ps_dates (StartDate);

---

USING GEOMETRY_GRID
WITH (BOUNDING_BOX = (xmin = 0, ymin = 0, xmax = 500, ymax = 200), GRIDS = (LOW, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH), CELLS_PER_OBJECT = 64);

================================================================================

KEY INDEX PK_JobCandidate_JobCandidateID ON (ft_catalog, FILEGROUP ft_group)
WITH (CHANGE_TRACKING = AUTO, STOPLIST = SYSTEM);

ALTER INDEX IX_x ON dbo.t REORGANIZE PARTITION = 3 WITH (LOB_COMPACTION = ON);
